environment.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

methodology.fixturePreparation: Synthetic rows allocated before measured export; baseline preparation normalizes every cell, worker preparation copies only outer matrix
methodology.inputArrivalMs: From immediately before postMessage to handler entry using performance.timeOrigin + performance.now; includes cold Worker startup, serialization, dispatch and deserialization; not isolated clone CPU
methodology.encodingMs: Measured inside dedicated instrumentation Worker using production buildWorkbookBuffer; includes normalization and encoding. Production worker checked independently by smoke test; cold static imports are included in inputArrivalMs.
methodology.baselineEncoding: Same installed write-excel-file/universal toBlob path; normalization, blobToArrayBuffer and Base64 helper taken from fixed Git baseline
methodology.responsiveness: 10ms timer gaps include scheduling and background effects; not measured long-task duration when WebKit longtask API unavailable
methodology.contentEquality: All xl/**/*.xml SHA-256 and workbook XML compared across baseline/worker/repetitions, including shared strings/styles; variable ZIP metadata ignored
methodology.fileWrite: Actual temporary-file write via Node loopback HTTP, without fsync; surrogate transport is explicitly not Tauri IPC or Rust write performance
